scope.initial_domain: one complete clip before any all-17 or corpus expansion

research_basis.bounded_claim: dynamically feasible retargeting jointly varies configuration, velocity, acceleration, actuator torque and scheduled contact force
a progressive KTO then inverse-dynamics then full-kinodynamic ladder can warm-start rather than cold-start the coupled solve
state and input values at time knots can be joint decision variables with dynamics enforced at collocation points
contact force can remain an optimization variable in constrained multibody dynamics

frozen_invariants.controller: fixed zero-residual PD with zero desired velocity and descriptor gains/caps
frozen_invariants.integer_emission: ties-to-even; exact emitted arrays are the offline gate

objective_priority: lexicographic required-safety feasibility with unchanged public limits
exact contact, collider, ROM and emitted root/joint velocity closure
rigid-body dynamics, scheduled contact-wrench and fixed-PD effort feasibility
tracking fidelity to the admitted source motion and passing V7 controls
smoothness and numerical regularization with no acceptance authority

stage_0_model_identity.purpose: bind every offline dynamics quantity and convention to descriptor, native PhysX and derived-USD lineage before implementing equations
required_inventory: 24 body masses, centers of mass, full/principal inertias and principal frames
23 joint parent/child frames, axes, coordinate signs and limits
23 fixed-PD gains, effort clips, effort slew, target delta, work and power caps
all colliders, collision exclusions, material/friction and gravity
60 Hz target hold, 240 Hz state integration and four substeps per motor tick
root generalized-coordinate convention and contact-wrench frame/order
stage_0_model_identity.output: hash-bound report only; no generated dynamics model or candidate artifact

stage_1_quantization_aware_kto.decision_variables: floating-base q/v/a plus all 23 joint q/v/a at 60 Hz
stage_1_quantization_aware_kto.initialization: V9 complete clip; V7 is a tracking/safety prior, never an independently admissible splice
constraints: frozen contact modes with active-point position and velocity closure
all exact collider boxes, soft ROM and public root/joint velocity limits
fixed 60 Hz timing and exact hybrid velocity stencil
ties-to-even emitted integer audit inside every accepted-iterate decision
stage_1_quantization_aware_kto.output: ephemeral warm start only; no corpus or controller target artifact
stage_1_quantization_aware_kto.pass_gate: exact emitted complete clip PASS with nonzero tracking progress; native control regression remains unclaimed until a later fresh-scene discriminator
stage_1_quantization_aware_kto.failure_gate: STOP_AND_RESEARCH; no margin, rounding repair or coefficient sweep

stage_2_fixed_pd_inverse_dynamics.decision_variables: 240 Hz generalized acceleration, 23 actuator efforts and scheduled contact wrenches
stage_2_fixed_pd_inverse_dynamics.inputs: stage-1 q/v/a warm start plus hash-bound body/joint/actuator/material/gravity model
constraints: floating-base rigid-body equations and active-contact acceleration closure
friction/wrench cones and inactive-contact zero wrench
descriptor effort, effort-rate, target-delta, velocity, power and positive-work limits
requested versus clipped/applied fixed-PD effort identity at every substep
stage_2_fixed_pd_inverse_dynamics.output: residual and feasibility report plus ephemeral torque/wrench warm start
stage_2_fixed_pd_inverse_dynamics.failure_disposition: continue only into the predeclared full kinodynamic coupling; do not relax the model

stage_3_full_kinodynamics.decision_variables: 240 Hz floating-base state, fixed-PD effort state and scheduled contact wrenches with 60 Hz reference targets
constraints: discrete rigid-body/contact dynamics at every physics substep
exact four-substep target hold, zero desired velocity, effort clipping and slew
frozen contact schedule, collision exclusions and all public safety limits
ties-to-even 60 Hz reference emission and exact offline complete/slice identity
stage_3_full_kinodynamics.output: in-memory exact candidate metrics only until a later formulation separately authorizes an artifact
stage_3_full_kinodynamics.pass_gate: exact offline zero plus separately formulated bounded fresh-scene discriminator
stage_3_full_kinodynamics.failure_gate: STOP_AND_RESEARCH; no all-17, corpus admission or training
